prediction.model: LightGBM on physics features + Sightglass rationale engine
prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 53.0 °C (71% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 59.3 °C (52% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 57.7 °C (60% above healthy). Rapid temperature accumulation with minimal inlet-outlet drop indicates loss of cooling circulation.
Valve: close to total failure. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.75 s (within 1% of healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.70 s (5% above healthy). Prolonged pressure rise time and marked switching lag between pressure lines point to severe directional valve response lag.
Pump leakage: weak leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 3.28 l/min (50% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 798 W·min/l (108% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 29.8 % (49% below healthy). Volumetric delivery is slightly compromised due to minor internal bypass flow.
Accumulator: severely reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 57.3 bar (23% above healthy). Dampening capacity is substantially impaired, producing high-frequency pressure oscillations across the circuit.
